params.body:
## Why

Two of the three key figures from #461 could not be recorded: the plan held TUI Stiftung and Securex with terms left open, and the Standard refuses a figure whose publisher's terms are unknown. That is now decided: both may be cited, with attribution. Neither is a competitor.

## What changes

- `research/statistics-2026-11-15-terms-open.json` becomes `research/statistics-2026-11-16.json`, with `terms: "attribution"` on both publishers. The figures themselves are unchanged:
  - 55% of 16 to 26 year olds in seven European countries can imagine becoming self-employed (TUI Stiftung, Junges Europa 2026, page 78, n=8,024).
  - 31.8% of new open-ended contracts in Belgium went to employees under 30 in 2025, from 40.3% in 2024 (Securex press release of 5 February 2026). This is a figure about employment contracts, not about self-employment.
- The test reads the new plan: both figures are taken, and the same plan without terms is still refused.

## After the merge, on the box

```
node bin/cite-statistics.mjs research/statistics-2026-11-16.json --admitted-by=<name> --run=figures-2026-11-16 --dry
node bin/cite-statistics.mjs research/statistics-2026-11-16.json --admitted-by=<name> --run=figures-2026-11-16
```

Undo with `node bin/cite-statistics.mjs --undo=figures-2026-11-16`.

## Checked

- Full suite and `tsc` pass on main at 1d6f2e7.
